description:
Intent i026 (SNAPSHOT=s05, BRANCH=callee-pull-caller-stale) completed with an evidence-backed negative result: no credible interprocedural stale-pointer variant found, and the priority l2tp surface is safe.

Priority surface audited line-by-line: the never-fully-read net/l2tp/ receive/dequeue interactions. The central callee l2tp_v3_ensure_opt_in_linear() (net/l2tp/l2tp_core.h:301-319) internally calls pskb_may_pull(skb, off + opt_len) at line 309 (attacker-influenced length derived from session config), which on a non-linear/cloned skb runs __pskb_pull_tail() -> pskb_expand_head() and frees/replaces skb->head. But this callee is the in-tree exemplar of the seed's fix, not a variant: it takes unsigned char **ptr and **optr and repairs both after the pull (lines 312-315, 'if (skb->data != *optr) { *optr = skb->data; *ptr = skb->data + off; }'), with the skb->data != *optr comparison detecting head relocation.

All three callers pass pointer-to-pointer so the repair applies and no pre-call pointer is dereferenced after return: l2tp_udp_recv_core (net/l2tp/l2tp_core.c:884, repaired pair forwarded to l2tp_recv_common at 887), l2tp_ip_recv (net/l2tp/l2tp_ip.c:164), l2tp_ip6_recv (net/l2tp/l2tp_ip6.c:177). l2tp_recv_common itself (l2tp_core.c:616-770) receives ptr/optr by value and dereferences them only BEFORE its interior attacker-influenced pskb_may_pull(skb, offset) at line 734; after the pull only __skb_pull and L2TP_SKB_CB(skb)->length/expires writes to skb->cb occur (cb is not part of skb->head, so immune to head relocation). The dequeue dispatch l2tp_recv_dequeue_skb -> (*session->recv_skb)(session, skb, L2TP_SKB_CB(skb)->length) at l2tp_core.c:413 holds no head pointer across the call boundary, and both in-tree recv_skb callbacks are safe: l2tp_eth_dev_recv (net/l2tp/l2tp_eth.c:138/145 pull before capture) and pppol2tp_recv (net/l2tp/l2tp_ppp.c:231 'if (pskb_may_pull(skb, 2) && skb->data[0] == PPP_ALLSTATIONS && skb->data[1] == PPP_UI)' — the pull is the left operand of && so the reads are post-pull, the correct-order twin of the seed).

8 candidates classified safe with exact file:line evidence; 0 findings. Bounded negative result: the broad callee->caller census across s05 net/ and drivers/ was drafted but not executed before finalization (limitation), same-function surfaces already classified by the concluded s05 rx-pull/loop-parser artifacts were skipped per intent, and drivers/ RX handlers outside net/l2tp/ plus the dynamic KASAN verification remain unexamined limitations. Full artifact with all 8 candidates, evidence, and 6 limitations is at agent-state/findings/i026.json.
